title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-22 12:54:05 最新章节：261万字李玄霄 朕杀的就是圣人屠圣原始天魔
slug: 洪荒我在截教结算证道
content_zh:
茫茫洪荒，无边东海。
相传，截教圣人通天教主的道场金鳌岛便在这东海之中。
李玄霄于百年前穿越而来，带着问道混元、证道圣人的宏大理想，学着后世的孙猴子，孤帆入海以求仙缘。
结果李玄霄的小船刚出海没几天就遭遇海啸，若不是偶遇前往三仙岛的截教外门弟子石矶，被其所救，差点就出师未捷身先死了。
之后，石矶便带着李玄霄一同去了三仙岛。
三仙岛上，李玄霄得见了云霄、琼霄、碧霄三位仙子。
三霄仙子见李玄霄求道心切，又颇为有眼缘，便加以引荐，李玄霄因此得以拜在通天教主门下。
只可惜李玄霄出身不过寻常人族，根骨一般，天资平平，只做了个记不住名字的记名弟子。
转眼间，百年时光便是过去。
这百年间，李玄霄也就有幸聆听通天教主讲过一次道，其余时间多是在自己寻得的一处“洞府”中独自修炼。
截教虽号称有教无类，但弟子和弟子之间，差距还是太大了。
亲传、内门、外门再到自己这种记名弟子，其中隔着的是道道天堑。
亲传、内门弟子们随侍圣人左右聆听大道，外门弟子也多有机缘得见圣人，他们的法宝丹药从不短缺。
至于自己这种记名弟子……
只能在教中师兄、师姐每年一次的公开讲道时，远远坐在最后排，听来几句讲道的余音。
运气好的时候，能领悟一二；运气不好的时候，听了也只是徒耗时间。
以至于现在百年过去了，作为圣人记名弟子的李玄霄，尚未迈入地仙境界……
“这可太现实了！”
他也曾想过，是否要与通天教主说明了身份，以通晓的洪荒未来走势换个坦途前程，但转念细想，其中变数过多，风险过高。
最后，李玄霄也认清了现实，不若就安安稳稳做个截教记名弟子，平日里多修行，多结识些师兄弟。

等到了封神量劫时期，自己在万仙阵中走上一遭，上个封神榜，做天庭神仙，拿一个铁饭碗。
这般似乎也是极好的。
毕竟，多少人经历万千磨难，为的也只是想要成仙、做神，谋得长生。
而自己，只需要按部就班，似乎就能上封神榜做天庭神仙，这也是不差的。
更何况，如今洪荒不安，巫妖两族厉兵秣马，在准备着最后的决战，留在金鳌岛好好修炼方才是上策。
李玄霄是这般想的，也是这般做的。
日子就这样一天又一天过去。
可问题是，李玄霄这么多年过去了，竟还未成就地仙境界！
一开始李玄霄还以姜子牙安慰自己，毕竟那姜子牙作为元始天尊的亲传弟子，在玉虚宫修炼了几十年亦是未入仙道。
但这般便导致了一个很严重的后果，自己恐时日无多！
能在洪荒世界，混到寿元将尽，这怕也是头一遭了。
直到这一日！
在自己那极为简陋的洞府中打坐修炼的李玄霄猛然睁开眼来。
只因为随自己一同穿越而来的一面古镜竟突然散出阵阵柔光。
“莫非，此前是这古镜在吸收我所修炼之灵气？”
“这套路，我熟。”
李玄霄将之取出，随后只见得这古镜之上，显露数十行字来。
【百年结算开始！】
content_en:
The vast wilderness, the boundless East China Sea.
According to legend, Jin'ao Island, the dojo of the sage Tongtian, is located in the East China Sea.
Li Xuanxiao traveled through time a hundred years ago, with the grand ideal of asking about Hunyuan and becoming a saint. He followed the example of Sun Houhou of later generations and sailed into the sea alone to seek immortality.
As a result, Li Xuanxiao's boat encountered a tsunami just a few days after setting out to sea. If he hadn't accidentally met and rescued Shi Ji, an outer disciple of Jiejiao who was going to Sanxian Island, he would have almost died before leaving.
After that, Shi Ji took Li Xuanxiao to Sanxian Island.
On the Three Immortals Island, Li Xuanxiao met the three fairies Yunxiao, Qiongxiao, and Bixiao.
Fairy Sanxiao saw that Li Xuanxiao was eager to seek Taoism and had a good eye, so she recommended her, and Li Xuanxiao was able to worship the leader of Tongtian Cult.
It's a pity that Li Xuanxiao was not from an ordinary human race, with average bones and mediocre talents. He was only a registered disciple who could not remember his name.
In the blink of an eye, a hundred years have passed.
In the past hundred years, Li Xuanxiao was lucky enough to listen to Master Tongtian's sermon once, and spent the rest of the time practicing alone in a "cave" he found.
Although Jie Jiao claims to teach without distinction, the gap between disciples is still too big.
From personal disciples, inner sects, outer sects to registered disciples like myself, there are many natural chasms between them.
The direct disciples and inner disciples accompanied the saint to listen to the great truth. The outer disciples often had the opportunity to meet the saint, and their magic pills were never in short supply.
As for a named disciple like myself...
I can only sit far away in the back row during the annual public sermons given by my senior brothers and sisters, and hear the lingering sounds of a few words of the sermon.
When you are lucky, you can understand a thing or two; when you are unlucky, listening is just a waste of time.
So much so that one hundred years have passed, and Li Xuanxiao, who is the saint's registered disciple, has not yet entered the realm of earthly immortals...
"This is so realistic!"
He had also thought about whether he should reveal his identity to the Tongtian Cult Leader and exchange his knowledge of the prehistoric future trends for a smooth future, but when he thought about it more carefully, he realized that there were too many variables and the risks were too high.
In the end, Li Xuanxiao also recognized the reality. It would be better to remain a registered disciple of Jiejiao, practice more on weekdays, and get to know more fellow disciples.
When it comes to the period of Conferring Gods and Measuring Tribulation, I will go through the Ten Thousand Immortals Formation, get on the Conferred Gods List, become a Heavenly God, and get an iron rice bowl.
This seems to be very good.
After all, how many people have gone through countless hardships just to become immortals, gods, and live forever.
As for me, I just need to follow the steps, and it seems that I can be on the list of gods and become a heavenly god, which is not bad.
What's more, now that the world is in turmoil, the Lich and Lich clans are preparing for the final decisive battle. It is best to stay on Jin'ao Island and practice hard.
This is what Li Xuanxiao thought and did.
The days passed like this day after day.
But the problem is, after all these years, Li Xuanxiao has yet to achieve the realm of Earthly Immortal!
At first, Li Xuanxiao comforted himself with Jiang Ziya. After all, Jiang Ziya, as a direct disciple of Yuanshi Tianzun, had practiced in Yuxu Palace for decades and had not yet entered the immortal way.
But this has led to a very serious consequence, and I am afraid that my time is running out!
This is probably the first time that he has been able to survive until the end of his life in the ancient world.
Until this day!
Li Xuanxiao, who was meditating in his extremely simple cave, suddenly opened his eyes.
Just because an ancient mirror that traveled through time with him suddenly emitted bursts of soft light.
"Could it be that this ancient mirror was absorbing the spiritual energy I cultivated before?"
"I'm familiar with this routine."
Li Xuanxiao took it out, and then saw dozens of lines of words revealed on the ancient mirror.
[The centenary settlement begins! 】
